title: Maintainer publishes documentation from merged main
summary: A supervised documentation publication accepts only the exact clean merged main subject and records immutable source provenance.
preconditions: The intended source commit is available from origin
The publication is explicitly initiated by a human maintainer

steps.action: Verify the source checkout is clean and exactly equals merged main and origin/main
steps.expected_outcome: Every branch-only, dirty, detached, stale, or unmerged subject is refused

steps.action: Authorize publication of the verified source subject
steps.expected_outcome: Published output records the exact source commit and tree

postconditions: Publication provenance resolves to an exact merged-main commit and tree

acceptance_criteria.statement: Publication refuses every source subject other than the exact clean merged main and origin/main commit.
A successful supervised publication records source provenance bound to the merged-main commit and tree.
